newsitem.title: ROMANIA: BUCHAREST SHARES RISE, TURNOVER UP ON SPECIAL DEAL.
newsitem.headline: BUCHAREST SHARES RISE, TURNOVER UP ON SPECIAL DEAL.

text.p: 1215 GMT - Most shares on the Bucharest stock exchange posted gains in their average and closing prices on Friday under strong buying pressure.
* Heavier trading, as well as a special deal in Oltchim chemical plant sent turnover higher to 7.5 billion lei from 6.7 billion on Thursday.
* Volume was 2.5 million shares, up from 2.3 million the previous day.
* The first tier dominated trading, accounting for 80 percent of turnover.
* Busier activity in several stocks on the second tier - including attraction Policolor dye maker -- took volume in this section higher to around 450,000 shares from 363,000.
* Interest in the other second-tier listings remained minor, with nine of the 36 stocks having no trade. Three companies were suspended. ($=7,110 lei)
